correctness.rationale: Analytic proof: shortest paths change each endpoint-different coordinate once; reflection principle counts binary words by distance to the monotone chain, giving B_l; third symbols contribute constant mismatches, which factor the enumerator. Farthest-vertex construction proves the exact d-ceil(s/2) bound. Direct path and reversal pairing counts all optimal geodesics, including the singleton boundary. The independent-from-formula enumerator checked 65 binary profiles, 1474 mixed profiles, and all unoriented geodesics in 12 small mixed instances. Finite checks are supplementary only.
